message.content:
This editorial illustration features three caricatured male figures riding horses against a blurred background of a light-colored building with columns. The central figure has an elongated face, a wide toothy grin, and large ears. He wears a cylindrical black hat with horizontal gold stripes and a dark blue jacket with gold trim and two star-shaped gold ornaments. He holds black reins. To his left, a figure with glasses and a black hat sits on a brown horse. To the central figure's right, a third figure with a broad smile wears a black hat and jacket. In the lower right foreground, the head of a white horse is visible.

A red vertical bar borders the left side. Large grey text at the top reads "TEMPO," with the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" underneath. Other legible text includes "JEBOL DANA SUBSIDI BIOSOLAR," "SENGKETA LAHAN SAWIT DI MALUKU TENGAH," and "PANGGUNG POLITIK TRAH JOKOWI." A block of smaller white text appears on the right. The bottom left corner contains a barcode, a QR code, and the text "16-21 JUNI 2020" and "RP 45.000."
